**Agent Name:** Planner  
**Step Number:** 14  
**Reason for Mistake:** The Planner incorrectly concluded that the director of "Say It with Flowers" (John Baxter) died later than the director of "Boot Hill Bandits" (S. Roy Luby). This error arose from the misinterpretation of the provided death dates. While the accurate death dates were gathered correctly (John Baxter died on January 21, 1975, and S. Roy Luby on August 19, 1976), the Planner failed to properly compare these dates chronologically to determine which was later. Instead, the Planner incorrectly reversed the comparison, leading to the erroneous conclusion that John Baxter died later when, in fact, S. Roy Luby died over a year later. This failure aligns with the common error of misinterpreting temporal data when performing comparative analyses, as described in Example 1.
